errors.text_span: Етикетите са разположени през интервали от 6 години
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the x-axis labels are at 6-year intervals. They are categorical age ranges of varying sizes (e.g., 19-25 is 7 years, 26-34 is 9 years).

errors.text_span: Оста Y е с линейна скала, варираща между 0% и 64%, с етикети, разположени на интервали от 8%
errors.evidence: The y-axis range does not end at 64%; that is simply the maximum data point shown. The axis grid lines are not at 8% intervals; they appear to be at 20% intervals.
The chart contains five data series (lines), not four. The line for '5 Силно несъгласен' (dark blue) is completely omitted from the description.

errors.text_span: Синята линия ... започва от стойност 48% при 19-25 възраст
errors.evidence: The blue line starts at 25% for the 19-25 age group, not 48%. It reaches 48% at the next age group (26-34).
The blue line increases to 48% for the 26-34 age group. The description incorrectly states that it decreases and provides a wrong value (28%).

errors.text_span: след което се увеличава до 44% при 35-44 възраст
errors.evidence: The trend is incorrect. The blue line decreases from 48% (at 26-34) to 44% (at 35-44), it does not increase.

errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия, обозначена с триъгълни маркери
errors.evidence: The markers for all lines, including the orange one, are circular, not triangular.
The orange line starts at 13% for the 19-25 age group, not 28%.
The orange line increases to 26% for the 26-34 age group. The description incorrectly states it decreases and gives a value (20%) that belongs to the yellow line.
The orange line reaches a peak of 64% for the 45+ age group, not 36%. The value 36% belongs to the blue line at that age group.

errors.text_span: Сивата линия, обозначена с квадратни маркери
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies this line. The grey line from the legend ('3 Не мога да преценя') is omitted, and this description seems to be a hallucination or a misidentification of another line. The line described here has values that don't match any single line on the chart, and the markers are circular, not square.
This describes the start of the grey line correctly (13%), but the subsequent points are incorrect and mix values from other lines.

errors.text_span: намалява до 4% при 26-34 възраст, след това се увеличава до 12% при 35-44 възраст
errors.evidence: This description combines data from two different lines. The grey line decreases to 4% (26-34) and then to 2% (35-44). The dark blue line decreases to 2% (26-34) and is at 12% at 35-44. The described trend (decrease then increase) is incorrect for any single line.
The grey line ends at 0% for the 45+ age group, not 2%.

errors.text_span: Жълтата линия, обозначена с диамантни маркери
errors.evidence: The markers are circular, not diamond-shaped.
The yellow line starts at 22%, not 13%. The description is likely confusing it with the grey or orange line.

errors.text_span: намалява до 12% при 26-34 възраст, след което се увеличава до 16% при 35-44 възраст
errors.evidence: The yellow line decreases from 22% to 20% (at 26-34) and then further decreases to 16% (at 35-44). The description invents an incorrect value (12%) and an incorrect trend (increase).

The description states the chart shows data for age groups and response categories but omits the topic of the survey responses, which is available in the reference context ('Работа от разстояние...').
The description does not mention that the Y-axis represents percentages.
The description completely omits the legend, failing to connect the colored lines to their corresponding response categories (e.g., blue is 'Силно съгласен').
